assumptions: vsi = vsi::vsi_rgb8 -> vsi_planes on rgb8_planes opponent channels L=0.06R+0.63G+0.27B, M=0.30R+0.04G-0.35B, N=0.34R-0.60G+0.17B plus a planar RGB copy for SDSP (kernel.rs:731-783).

SDSP per image (kernel.rs:1068-1189): antialiased-bilinear imresize of R,G,B to 256x256 (two separable passes, triangle kernel broadened to support 2/scale on shrink, normalized weights), sRGB->Lab D50 (scalar f64: 3 lin() pow paths, 3x3 XYZ matrix, 3 f() cube-root pows, Lab outputs), per-channel fft2 + log-Gabor multiply + ifft2, magnitude accumulate, cached centre prior multiply, warm-colour prior (minmax scan + normalize + expf + fold), imresize back to WxH, mat2gray.

imresize tap count: shrink support 2/scale rounded up plus the pad window gives ~ceil(2/scale)+2 weighted taps per output (kernel.rs:93-208); each tap is one mul + one add (weights normalized at table build). Upscale taps ~3.

fft2 per channel (fft.rs): N=256 radix-2; per output element of the 2-D transform ~log2(N) butterflies per axis direction = 8 butterflies x (4 mul + 4 add); counted for both fft2 and ifft2; twiddle table setup is per-process and excluded.
Log-Gabor grid and Gaussian centre window are LazyLock per-process constants (kernel.rs:1020-1061, 1128-1145) - counted once here as elements=1 stages' worth omitted (constant, not per-image).

Decimation F=max(1,round(min(w,h)/256)) (kernel.rs:30-32); conv2(ones(F)/F^2,'same') + decimate on L,M,N,SM per image = 5 planes. h-pass keeps only retained columns (w2*h tmp), v-pass F adds + 1 mul (kernel.rs:1198-1236).
Scharr magnitude on decimated luma: two conv2_same_3x3 (9 mul + 8 add each, zero-padded 'same') + sqrtf(gx^2+gy^2) per image.

Pool (kernel.rs:1451-1545): per element four similarity terms (2ab+C)/(a^2+b^2+C) [each mul4 add3 div1], powf(gsim,ALPHA), iq=isim*qsim, sign-select + powf(|iq|,LAMBDA) + cos blend, max(sm1,sm2) weight, contrib=gpow*vssim*iqreal*w, f64 accumulate. NaN semantics per reference.
Span: SDSP fft is a barrier (global); pooling is a barrier reduction. Quality map not emitted by the scored path (map=None).
vsi-k2 = Downscale::Factor(2); all decimated-res stages use F=2.

stages.name: opponent L/M/N dots + planar RGB copy
stages.notes: 3 dots (3 mul + 2 add + 3 cvt each) + 3 rgb cvt/stores

stages.name: SDSP imresize channels -> 256x256 (two separable passes)
stages.notes: col pass emits 3*W*256, row pass 3*256*256; taps ~ceil(2/scale)+2

stages.name: sRGB->Lab (D50) on 256x256 per channel set
stages.notes: per px: 3 lin() (div+cmp+add+div+pow) + 3x3 XYZ (9mul+6add) + 3 f() (cmp+pow) + Lab out (3mul+3add); common pow path counted

stages.name: log-Gabor bandpass per channel: fft2, LG multiply, ifft2
stages.notes: fft2+ifft2 ~8 butterflies/elem x (4mul+4add) + LG mul2 on the complex pair

stages.name: magnitude sqrt, centre prior mul, warm-colour prior
stages.notes: 3x re^2 fma + sqrtf + GW mul + minmax 4cmp + (norm 2sub 2div + d2 2mul 1add + arg div + expf + (1-e)add + mul)

stages.name: imresize 256x256 -> W x H + mat2gray
stages.notes: upscale taps ~3-4; mat2gray min/max scan (2cmp) + (v-lo)/range amortized over taps

stages.name: box-filter h-pass on retained cols of L,M,N,SM
Scharr gx,gy conv2 3x3 + magnitude on decimated luma
stages.notes: two 3x3 convs (zero-pad 'same'); sqrt(gx^2+gy^2) costs per luma elem -> half per conv-out elem; mul/add per tap 9 incl accumulate

stages.name: 4-term similarity + powers + weighted pool
stages.notes: vssim/gsim/isim/qsim each mul4 add3 div1; powf x2; sign-select ops approx; contrib mul3; f64 adds+cvt
